name: Failure of the Political Seizure of the UNR in Kyiv (November – December 1917) (C0071)

techniques.comment: Deliberate transfer of loyal delegates and political agitators to the All-Ukrainian Congress of Soviets in Kyiv in order to hijack the agenda from within(Citation: Відносини держави, суспільства і особи під час створення радянського ладу в Україні (1917 – 1938 рр.) 2013).

An attempt to convert an electoral minority into a procedural majority at the congress. Actual support was negligible: in the Constituent Assembly elections "across the country as a whole the Bolsheviks gathered less than 24% of the votes, and in the Ukrainian gubernias only 10%"(Citation: Відносини держави, суспільства і особи під час створення радянського ладу в Україні (1917 – 1938 рр.) 2013). Hence the wager on capturing representative bodies: the Central Committee of the RSDLP(b) declared outright that "the transfer of government from the hands of one soviet party into the hands of another party is secured without any revolution, by a simple decision of the Soviets, by a simple re-election of deputies to the Soviets," while the All-Russian Central Executive Committee's decree of 4 December 1917 "On the right of recall of delegates" provided the mechanism for such a replacement(Citation: Відносини держави, суспільства і особи під час створення радянського ладу в Україні (1917 – 1938 рр.) 2013)(Citation: Декрет ВЦИК «О праве отзыва делегатов» 1917).

Use by the Council of People's Commissars of local Bolshevik cells as a legal political force that was to speak on behalf of the Ukrainian proletariat against the Central Rada(Citation: Україна й українці в постімперську добу (1917—1939) 2021).
